episodes.157576: Some pulse thunderstorms produced some gusty winds as they collapsed.
episodes.157586: High temperatures more than 20 degrees above normal and a slowly approaching low pressure trough combined with a favorable atmosphere to develop a few severe thunderstorms during the evening hours.
episodes.157592: Scattered thunderstorm activity led to sporadic gusty winds over portions of the Chesapeake Bay and tidal Potomac River.
episodes.157770: A few isolated severe thunderstorms produced some large hail and strong wind gusts.
episodes.158004: A short-wave trough passing through the area led to some very early morning thunderstorms with gusty winds developing. One storm produced severe wind gusts of 58 mph near Watford City in McKenzie County.
episodes.158264: Severe thunderstorm outflow winds were measured across portions of eastern Carbon and Platte Counties with wind speeds in excess of 58 mph.
episodes.158695: Deep tropical moisture across NE FL combined with diurnal instability and sea breeze and outflow boundary mergers produced a few pulse strong storms.
episodes.158774: An upper disturbance moving through the Upper Great Lakes produced a strong thunderstorm at Rock of Ages Light on the evening of the 4th.
episodes.158775: An upper level disturbance moving across the Upper Great Lakes initiated a severe thunderstorm which tracked over Isle Royale on the evening of the 4th.
episodes.158974: Brief waterspouts were observed in Galveston Bay, near San Leon.
episodes.159307: Thunderstorms developed beneath an upper level low and some produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
episodes.159679: A passing mid-level shortwave along with the interaction of a sea breeze circulation and outflow boundaries from ongoing convection led to a few stronger thunderstorms across southeast Georgia.
episodes.159680: The combination of warm and moist conditions along with forcing associated with a weak mid-level shortwave aloft and an inland moving sea breeze circulation, led to strong to severe thunderstorms during afternoon hours.
episodes.159962: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a trough of low pressure produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
episodes.160277: A severe thunderstorm developed late in the evening on June 4, bringing primarily severe wind gusts to the central Red River Valley.
